example.title: Corner bar in a black-painted brick building with a vertical sign
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A small two-storey brick corner bar painted black on the ground floor with red brick above, a tall vertical sign with bulb lettering down the corner, small high windows, a steel door, planters and a ficus tree on the sidewalk. Two photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
